description: A silver foil drink pouch, taut and cold, sloshing faintly when you tilt it. A cartoon sun with a dead-eyed smile beams off the front above the words SOYLENT — SUNSHINE IN A POUCH! A rigid straw is glued to the side in shrink-wrap, its tip filed to a point sharp enough to stab the foil.
name: soylent pouch

tags.description: A silver foil drink pouch, taut and cold, sloshing faintly when you tilt it. A cartoon sun with a dead-eyed smile beams off the front above the words SOYLENT — SUNSHINE IN A POUCH! A rigid straw is glued to the side in shrink-wrap, its tip filed to a point sharp enough to stab the foil.
tags.use_message: You tear the straw free, punch it through the foil, and slurp. It comes up body-warm and thick, and for one lurching second it tastes almost like a person you used to know — a mouthful of somebody's memory, chalky and salt and gone. You suck the pouch flat with a wet crackle and try very hard not to think about where the sunshine comes from.
